categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: Electromechanical Systems and Automation Products (52.37% of revenue), Air Conditioning and Home Appliances (19.08%), and Electromechanical Engineering and Power Equipment (21.39%). Additional activities include logistics, communication products, software services, real estate leasing, manpower dispatch, and financial investments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-efficiency motors (IE4 and IE5 standards), permanent magnet motors, variable frequency drives, servo systems, electric vehicle powertrain systems, transformers, and energy storage systems. Production involves casting, stamping, electrical and mechanical assembly, design, and system integration. The company also develops smart energy management, hydrogen fuel cells, and IoT-enabled HVAC solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span industrial sectors such as power plants, steel, petrochemical, metallurgy, mining, water treatment, and automation equipment manufacturers. The air conditioning and home appliance segment serves residential, commercial, industrial users, retailers, government agencies, and builders. Electromechanical engineering targets renewable energy projects, data centers, public infrastructure, and transportation sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with sales and production facilities in Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia), India, Mexico, the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. It actively expands in emerging markets like India, Mexico, and Southeast Asia while maintaining strong presence in North America, Europe, and Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing electromechanical products and providing integrated engineering solutions. It sources raw materials like silicon steel, copper wire, aluminum, and bearings from domestic and international suppliers and delivers finished products and turnkey projects to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on green energy, electrification, energy saving and carbon reduction, and regional market expansion. R&D emphasizes high-efficiency motors (IE5), electric vehicle powertrains, hydrogen energy applications, smart grid components, energy storage systems, and smart HVAC solutions. The company also invests in digital transformation, AI integration, and sustainable product innovation aligned with ESG goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electromechanical systems, air conditioning and home appliances, and engineering services including project management and turnkey solutions. Additional income streams include logistics services, software and IT services, real estate leasing, and financial investments. The company also benefits from government subsidies and strategic acquisitions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading brand in electromechanical systems and automation, ranking 5th globally in motor market share. Competitors include domestic firms like Tatung and Sampo, and international players such as ABB, Siemens, Delta, Yaskawa, Panasonic, Hitachi, and LG. It holds strong market positions in Taiwan, North America, and Southeast Asia, leveraging product quality, innovation, and global supply chain presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$55.2 billion in the latest fiscal year, a 7% decline from the previous year, with net profit around NT$6.25 billion, slightly down 1.3%. It maintains stable profitability despite market challenges, supported by cost control and asset optimization. The company has a robust asset base exceeding NT$124 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and strategic acquisitions to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes energy efficiency, sustainability, and smart automation as its core value propositions. It offers high-efficiency motors and integrated powertrain solutions that support customers' carbon reduction goals. Its products comply with international energy standards and incorporate advanced technologies like AI, IoT, and hydrogen fuel cells. The company also provides comprehensive energy management and engineering services, differentiating itself through innovation, quality, and global service capabilities.
